dedupe_keys.name: specification for the plan4res platform implementation

description: The plan4res team documents a coupled energy-system workflow linking investment, operational and supplementary models. The platform specification describes data transformation, optimisation and exchange between partner computing systems, with Universal Data Junction and SMS++ reference material. A companion case report states that MIM, DMEM and gas-network optimisation were used together to analyse European transition pathways and operational constraints. This record represents that documented coupled modelling workflow; it does not assert that every platform component is distributed in this deposit. Zenodo provides the specification freely under CC BY 4.0. Public workflow-support repositories have separate terms. Coverage is configurable, with the companion European case focused partly on 2040. Related StOpt and SMS++ records describe component solvers. A limitation is that complete software availability, version compatibility and reproducibility were not established. No document, README or code body was fetched.
